prose:
NBC's accessible opening reports Kathy Hochul signing a five-year New York restriction on manufacture and sale of chatbot-powered toys, with the law due to take effect in February. It places the signing on Tuesday and identifies New York as following California.

Most retrieved text after the opening is unrelated subscription navigation, not a full readable investigation. The headline and opening therefore do not verify every statutory exception, penalty or definition. They also differ from the Guardian's Wednesday signing wording; this summary preserves that source distinction and does not turn signing into immediate effectiveness or a ban on all AI-enabled toys.
highlights: Readable opening gives a five-year duration
February is a future effective period
Unrelated navigation is not article evidence
No full statutory audit was performed
